PROSE.rule: Old Prose routes are STALE_ARCHITECTURE_PENDING_RECONCILIATION. Any genuinely open integration result is an ordinary BOOK obligation, not a Prose route.

PROGRAMMING.rule: Programming engineering/product work is not dispatchable as CORE work. Only bounded Knowledge Recovery custody/provenance support uses CORE Second Shift capacity before Programming peer admission.

owner_discovery_rule: Controllers enumerate owner_files as active lanes and compare its keys against CURRENT-AUTHORITY topology peer_system_ids on every run. The sets must match exactly after machine-resolvable auto-provisioning. A missing owner file for an already-declared peer is provisioned only when control_ref, current owner head and current obligation are unambiguous; otherwise fail closed. Missing coverage never creates a new system and retired systems are never provisioned.
job_lock_rule: Before dispatch every delegation must conform to current topology, SYSTEM-PROGRAM-JOB-LOCK-001 and SYSTEM-COMPLETION-STATUS-001. A delegation that crosses another peer job, routes any Prose work to Documents, creates active Prose execution, dispatches Programming product work as CORE, silently creates a Programming peer lane, or claims completion of an incomplete active system is stale/invalid and must not dispatch.
system_lane_rule: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS are the active peer worker lanes. PROSE is terminally retired with no active or inherited lane. Programming remains a named non-peer work program with no peer worker lane until explicit topology admission.
portfolio_rule: The portfolio controller reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, job lock, Programming work-program lock, completion status, current obligation registry, repair registries, every owner file and live owner head. It rejects stale/non-open/cross-lane/retired-system work before dispatch and preserves independent lane/program progress.
day_shift_rule: When an active owner materially changes objective or completion standing, reconcile its delegation in the same working session. BOOK owns any remaining completed-Prose integration; DOCUMENTS receives none. Programming changes update its work-program lock/obligation but do not create a peer delegation before admission.
night_start_rule: Freshly re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, job lock, completion status, obligation registry, Programming work-program lock, repair state and live owner heads before execution; never trust stale snapshots.
dispatch_rule: Dispatch only job-conforming READY/CANDIDATE work in active peer lanes. While Knowledge Recovery 001 is selected, CORE uses owner-valid unattended-safe discretionary capacity for Programming proving-corpus recovery first, then remaining authorized catalog/archive recovery. PROGRAMMING product work itself has no peer Second Shift dispatch before explicit admission.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per active owner lane. PROSE has no claim domain. Programming has no peer claim domain before topology admission.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive finite classified retries; after exhaustion select independent safe work within the same owner job.
stale_rule: No job survives a live-head, current-obligation, job-lock, work-program-lock, topology, completion-status or retired-system mismatch. Preserve evidence/checkpoint, re-evaluate, then bind a current owner-valid delegation or work-program continuation.
no_work_rule: An active peer lane may be idle only after durable all-eight-rungs exhaustion for its own locked job. A blocker in another lane does not justify idling independent work. Retired systems require no lane or exhaustion proof.
successor_rule: After completion/material block, re-read live authority and select the next dependency-valid successor inside the same active lane job. Never bind a Prose successor. Programming successors remain inside its work-program lock until explicit admission.
utilization_rule: Active peer ledgers are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS only. Book-owned completed-Prose integration is recorded as BOOK work, not Prose activity. No new Prose telemetry is created or expected. Programming product work has no peer utilization ledger before admission; Knowledge Recovery support is recorded under CORE.
